note: The desk register: what this newsroom is configured to run, in one place. Two checks read it. The canary asserts the workflow files match it exactly, so a stale cron or a placeholder cannot survive a push. The morning tally compares the Actions log and the ledger to it and prints one health line. Cron times are UTC; the ET column is Eastern and shifts by an hour when DST ends on 1 November.
worker_dispatches: sports-news-brief.yml at the evening slot until Jack removes the window from the Worker; the run it starts skips

sports-news-brief.yml.purpose: OFF since 2026-10-12: the recap, storyline, lane and Edition job (was the one Edition run a day). Code kept.
sports-news-brief.yml.note: Gated on NEWSROOM_JOBS (unset), so any dispatch skips and spends nothing.

inactives.yml.purpose: The Sunday inactives poller. Its dated snapshots are the record.
inactives.yml.note: No model calls. A tick that captures nothing costs seconds and no commit.

verify-sports-pipeline.yml.note: Also runs on every push. Layer 1 is offline and makes no model call.

sports-aging.yml.purpose: Monthly aging review, and the venue-corrections review listing.

conditions-report.yml.purpose: The conditions report (Program 7, S-2b): written from the conditions Worker's numbers by template, gated, committed and pushed. Calls no model. Each run is one build.

newsroom: OFF from 2026-10-12 (Program 7, S-1 item 3): sports-news-brief.yml has no schedule key and its job is gated on the repository variable NEWSROOM_JOBS, unset. served_slots and the slot table in watcher.py are kept for the day it returns; no slot is served while it is off.
